death.note: Died before reaching fifty years of age.

relation.note: Served as amīr akhūr thālith during the time of his unnamed master/patron (ustādh). Active left empty: master not named in the source.

event.note: Resided there from his expulsion until his death.

event.desc: Expelled to Tripoli by Sultan al-Ẓāhir.
event.note: Date not specified, occurred after holding the office of amīr akhūr thālith. "al-Ẓāhir" is unnamed in the source; given the chronology (mamluk of al-Ashraf Barsbāy, d. before age 50) the expelling sultan is most plausibly al-Ẓāhir Jaqmaq (wd:Q647942 = #AIND-D02423), left unattributed here for lack of an explicit name.

person.note: アクバルディー・アル＝アシュラフィー・バルスバーイは、彼の主君（ウスターズ）の時代には第三のアーミール・アフール（厩舎長）であった。その後、アッ＝ザーヒル（スルタン）によってトリポリへアミールとして追放され、そこで50歳になる前に亡くなった。

Aqburdī al-Ashrafī Barsbāy was a third-rank amīr akhūr (master of the horse) in the days of his master. Al-Ẓāhir later expelled him to Tripoli as an amīr there, where he resided until his death before the age of fifty.
